newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GF COAL DETAILS CAPITALISATION AWARD.
newsitem.headline: GF COAL DETAILS CAPITALISATION AWARD.

text.p: Gold Fields Coal Ltd said on Tuesday that shareholders registered in the company's books on June 27 would be eligible for a capitalisation award.

In terms of the award, shareholders will receive new shares in the ratio that 64 cents bears to the average closing price of the firm's shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on July 24. Shareholders will have the right to renounce their entitlement to the award to Gold Fields Mining and Development Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of Gold Fields of South Africa Limited, in exchange for a cash dividend of 60 cents per share.
